br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A filter covering for a sterile container lid, for completely covering at least one gas exchange portion, which is provided on a lid component of the sterile container lid, on an outside of the sterile container lid, wherein the filter covering extends in a main plane, and the filter covering comprises:
at least two clip portions arranged opposite to each other, wherein the at least two clip portions are adapted to engage in a form-fitting manner in at least two clip receiving portions provided on the lid component, and by which the filter covering is mountable to and dismountable from the lid component without tools, and
a plate having a height, a length extending in the main plane and a width extending in the main plane, wherein the height is less than the length and less than the width,
wherein the at least two clip portions are formed as portions extending from the plate and bent away from the main plane, and each of the at least two clip portions comprises:a first end attached to the plate,
a curved surface extending from the first end and defining a bracket-shape or a C-shape having a concave side and a convex side opposite the concave side, and a second end defining a terminal free edge of the curved surface in a bracket- or a C-shaped manner,
wherein in a sectional view of the filter covering viewed along the main plane in which the at least two clip portions are provided, an entire section of the plate filter covering except for the at least two clip portions extends in the main plane, and the at least two clip portions bend in a first direction away from the main plane in the bracket- or C-shaped manner such that the respective concave sides of the respective curved surfaces face one another, and the respective terminal free edges ends of the clip portions face each other such that said respective ends of the clip portions are located closer to each other than respective portions of the two clip portions adjacent the ends respective curved surfaces immediately adjacent to the respective terminal free edges.
2. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is made of a plastic material in one piece.
3. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions are arranged on opposite sides and/or ends of the filter covering.
4. (Currently Amended) The filter covering according to claim 1, further comprising one or more supports extending from the plate in the first direction, between the respective first ends of the at least two clip portions, wherein the one or more supports are configured to space the plate from an adjacent surface when wherein the at least two clip portions are positioned to hold the filter covering against the adjacent surface.engage in the at least two clip receiving portions on opposite sides and/or ends of the lid component.
5. (Currently Amended) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is a rectangular plate is rectangular.
6. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions consist of exactly two clip portions.
7. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is rectangular with a first side, a second side opposite the first side, a third side, and a fourth side opposite the third side, the at least two clip portions being provided on the first side and the second side.
8. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 7, wherein the at least two clip portions are not provided on the third side and the fourth side.
9. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 7, wherein the first side and the second side are shorter than the third side and the fourth side, respectively, and Page 3 of 9
wherein the first side and the second side each comprise one of the at least two clip portions.
10. (Currently Amended) The filter covering according toclaim 11 claim 1, wherein the at least two clip portions are configured to be clipped onto the at least two clip receiving portions the respective curved surface of the first clip portion extends parallel to the main plane through a first distance, the grip portion extends parallel to the main plane from a first end to a second end through a second distance, and the second distance is less than the first distance.
11. (Currently Amended) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein each at least a first clip portion of the at least two clip portions is abracket-shaped side portion of the filter covering, and each bracket-shaped side portion comprises a laterally outwardly projecting comprises a grip portion projecting in a direction away from the plate, wherein the grip portion extends from the respective convex side of the first clip portion at a location between and spaced from the respective first end and the respective terminal free end of the first clip portion, the laterally outwardly projecting grip portions being manually operable when the filter covering is mounted to and dismounted from the lid component of the sterile container lid.
12. (Currently Amended) The filter covering according to claim 11, wherein each laterally outwardly projecting the grip portion extends parallel to the main plane.
13. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is made from amorphous thermoplastic and is transparent for visually inspecting a filter device arranged on a lid inner side of a gas exchange portion.
14. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is at least partially transparent.
15. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is an injection-molded part.
16. (Original) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the filter covering is elastically bendable.
17. (Currently Amended) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein each of said the respective terminal free edge of each clip portion respective ends of the clip portions is a clip portion end having is located at a greater a maximum distance from the main plane than any other part of the respective clip portion.
18. (Previously Presented) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein a "C" is formed between each of said respective ends of the clip portions and the main plane in the sectional view.
19. (Currently Amended) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein each of said respective curved surfaces immediately adjacent to the respective terminal free edges ends of the clip portions ends at a downward angle extending away from the main plane and towards an opposite one of the at least two clip portions.
20. (Previously Presented) The filter covering according to claim 1, wherein the plate extends in the main plane from a first edge at which a first one of the at least two clip portions is located to a second edge at which a second one of the at least two clip portions is located, and an entirety of the filter covering between the first edge and the second edge extends in the main plane.
